notes: Two more ways of saying things now land where you meant. Calling a clip flattering — "it looks flattering", "she looks flattering in this shot" — used to be read as a request for more contrast, and Crisp quietly planned a colour change over a compliment; praise is left alone now. And "make me a music clip" cuts a montage to the beat, the same as "make me a music video", which worked all along.
